slug.description: Active game slug. Injected by the workbench host; required.

assetPath.description: Game-relative path of the high-poly source mesh asset (its main GLB) to retopologize. The source is RETAINED; a NEW derived low-poly GLB asset is produced. NOT a pre-rig step — textures are NOT preserved.

assetName.description: Optional base name for the new low-poly asset. Defaults to <source-name>-lowpoly.

assetSlot.description: Slot for the new low-poly asset. Defaults to the source asset's slot.
